description: Propose removal of one enrolled speaker. Read speaker.list first for the exact speaker_id. The host asks for operator confirmation; a microphone or open speech session is not required. No storage path or confirmation stamp is supplied by the caller.

session_id.description: Optional session consistency check from speaker.list. Omit when managing enrollment without an open speech session.

speaker_id.description: Exact speaker_id to remove, as returned by speaker.list; not the display label.
